hooks.command: bash -c 'if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q "git commit"; then cd /home/user/sake-db-v2 && git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR | grep -E "\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|mjs|mts|json|css|md)$" | xargs -r npx prettier --write && git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR | grep -E "\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|mjs|mts|json|css|md)$" | xargs -r git add; fi'
